_note: Per-device firmware version history for the web flasher. To add a build: drop its <ver>-update.bin (the app image — byte-identical to the merged app region at 0x10000) somewhere under firmware/, then add one entry to that device's 'builds'. 'app' entries flash multi-part (that device's shared bootloader/partitions/boot_app0 + this app) — a clean bootable install that leaves SPIFFS/NVS intact. 'full' entries point at a complete merged.bin manifest.json (full erase). Newest first. 'latest:true' marks the default selection. P4 is intentionally not listed.

builds.note: 5.9.37's direct SD access (any-size images, saves via RAM-disk overlay) PLUS: an exFAT or NTFS card (the Windows default for 64GB+) is now detected at boot instead of 'SD MOUNT FAILED', and the GTi offers to format it as FAT32 itself - no third-party tools. Two confirmations, RED NO / GREEN YES, 1s arming delay. Quick format (boot sector + FATs); ERASES THE CARD. Reboots into a fresh /ADF /DSK /GENERIC layout.

DIRECT SD ACCESS (standalone): disk images are no longer copied into the RAM disk - the volume the Gotek sees is mapped straight onto the file on the card, so ANY size .adf/.dsk/.hfe/.st/.img mounts (up to 32MB). Saves still work: writes land in the RAM disk as an overlay and are written back as GameName.sav.<ext> exactly as before; DISKMAXKB now bounds how much of an image can be SAVED, not loaded. Wireless is unchanged (dongle RAM disk, DISKMAXKB ceiling). exFAT cards not supported. Also 5.9.36's boot-progress rework.

SD FW-UPDATE now refuses a merged/full-flash image up front (it can only ever flash the ~1.8MB app image) and shows the INCOMING firmware version on the confirm screen before you commit. Settings tab fully follows BTNSTYLE incl. the page/close bar. Keeps 5.9.29's /gti.log diagnostics, plus REEL BORDER and LAST USED.
